error.query_failed: Could not read the t3 database — the projections may have moved.

limits_gap_s.description: Least time between two limit checks for a provider; the checks themselves happen when work finishes
limits_gap_s.label: Limit Check Gap

poll_interval_ms.description: How often to re-read live threads and subagents from the t3 database
poll_interval_ms.label: Live Refresh

remote_names.description: Map each t3-connect environment id to a display name (e.g. "<environmentId>" = "My Server"); an unmapped one shows a shortened id
remote_names.label: Remote Names

remote_poll_s.description: How often to read the t3-code thread cache for threads on other connected machines
remote_poll_s.label: Remote Refresh

show_limits.description: Show how much of each Claude and Codex subscription window is spent, at the top of the dashboard
show_limits.label: Subscription Limits

show_remote.description: Show threads from other machines connected over t3-connect in the Threads list
show_remote.label: Remote Threads
